title: Cusp forms and parabolic cohomology classes for symmetric spaces of rank one
summary: For any rank-one Riemannian symmetric space S of non-compact type and any discrete, cofinite, non-cocompact, torsion-free group $Γ$ of orientation-preserving Riemannian isometries on S, we develop a cohomological interpretation for the cusp forms of $Γ$. To that end, we identify certain $Γ$-submodules of smooth semi-analytic vectors in the spherical principal series representation with spectral parameter $ν$ as well as certain subspaces of parabolic cohomology spaces of $Γ$ of degree dim S-1 with these $Γ$-submodules.
